# polar_custom_field (Resource)

Manages a Polar custom field. Custom fields allow you to collect additional information from customers during checkout.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the custom field.
- `slug` (String) Identifier of the custom field. Used as the key when storing the value. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
- `type` (String) The custom field type. Must be `text`, `number`, `date`, `checkbox`, or `select`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `metadata` (Map of String) Key-value metadata.
- `properties` (Attributes) Type-specific properties. Fields that don't apply to the current type should be omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The custom field ID.

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Optional:

- `form_help_text` (String) Help text shown below the field.
- `form_label` (String) Label shown on the form.
- `form_placeholder` (String) Placeholder text for the input.
- `ge` (Number) Minimum value (number and date types only).
- `le` (Number) Maximum value (number and date types only).
- `max_length` (Number) Maximum length (text type only).
- `min_length` (Number) Minimum length (text type only).
- `options` (Attributes List) List of selectable options (select type only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties--options))
- `textarea` (Boolean) Whether to render as a textarea (text type only).

<a id="nestedatt--properties--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties.options`

Required:

- `label` (String) The display label for the option.
- `value` (String) The option value.
